clauses.quote: A handicapped child's dependent status shall not terminate solely by reason of his/her having attained age 19, if such child is related to the employee as a natural or legally adopted child, a stepchild, or a child under legal guardianship, and if:
Within 31 days after the child turns 19, proof of the child's incapacity must be submitted to the Contract Administrator.
clauses.notes: passive construction; implicit agent is employee submitting proof

clauses.quote: Thereafter, continued proof of the disability may be required once per year.
clauses.notes: implicit agent is district administering benefit verification

clauses.quote: The District, at its expense, might require an independent medical or psychological verification.
A Dependent Status Review Committee shall be established consisting of two members of the Association and two representatives of the District.
This committee shall review concerns and appeals in the matter of dependent eligibility and make recommendations to the District.
Such newborn children automatically have coverage for the first thirty-one (31) days of life.
